Who We Are

360° Advance
CCTV Surveillance

100+
Projects Done

360 Advance CCTV Surveillance is a professional security company based in Pithampur Industrial Area, Dhar, MP. We specialize in CCTV installation, IP networking, DVR/NVR setup and AMC services for factories, offices, shops and homes.

As an authorized dealer for Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua & Uniview, we supply and install only genuine branded products. All jobs include site survey, installation, mobile app setup and post-installation support.

We are a Government-registered MSME business (UDYAM-MP-17-0077880) and GST registered (GSTIN: 23KFBPK6220L1ZF), operating with full transparency and competitive pricing.

FAQ

Common
Questions

How many cameras do I need for my home or shop?
+

For a typical home, 2–4 cameras covering the main entrance, back and living areas is sufficient. For a shop, 4–8 cameras depending on floor area. We do a free site visit to recommend the right number and placement.

Can I watch cameras on my mobile phone?
+

Yes. We configure Hik-Connect or iVMS-4500 app on your smartphone as part of every installation — at no extra cost. View live footage, playback recordings and receive motion alerts from anywhere in the world.

Do you provide warranty on cameras and DVR?
+

Yes. All products carry the manufacturer's warranty — typically 1 year for cameras and DVR/NVR. As authorized dealers of Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua and Uniview, warranty claims are fully supported.

What is AMC and do I need it?
+

AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) is a service agreement where we visit periodically to clean cameras, check connections, update firmware and fix any issues. It keeps your CCTV system working properly year-round. Contact us for AMC pricing.

Do you accept 3rd party or referral work?
+

Yes, we accept 3rd party work and referral projects. If you are an electrician, builder, IT company or any other business that needs CCTV installation for your clients, we can work professionally with you. Call us to discuss terms.

How long does installation take?
+

A standard 4-camera home or shop installation typically takes 4–6 hours and is completed in a single day. Larger factory or office installations may take 1–3 days depending on number of cameras and cable runs.
